events.name: Football watch party
events.description: There's a match screening at the neighborhood guard post. The night gets busier as workers & ride-hail drivers pour in.

events.name: Neighbor's celebration
events.description: A neighbor placed a bulk order! Prepare the portions before opening; they pay above the usual price.

events.name: Campus event
events.description: There's a festival on campus. Students flood the area until late.

events.name: Student association order
events.description: A student association placed a bulk order for their late-night meeting. Prepare the portions before opening.

events.name: Chili prices spike
events.description: Chili supplies are tight, so prices jump today.

events.name: Cheap eggs at the market
events.description: Farmers had a bumper harvest, so egg prices drop today.

events.name: Sugar shortage
events.description: Sugar is scarce, so prices go up.

events.name: Rolling blackout
events.description: Part of the neighborhood is dark. Fewer visitors.

events.name: Parking crackdown
events.description: There's a crackdown on illegal parking on the street. Fewer visitors.

events.name: Ride-hail meetup
events.description: A ride-hail drivers' community is gathering nearby tonight.

events.name: Food vlogger visit
events.description: A food vlogger drops by. If average satisfaction is ≥ 70, popularity rises; if it's poor, it drops.

events.name: Payday
events.description: People just got paid, so customers have looser budgets.

events.name: Dangdut concert on stage
events.description: There's a dangdut concert on the night market stage. Visitors pour in until late!

events.name: Fireworks party
events.description: The organizers set off fireworks. Lots of curious new visitors drop by.

events.name: Night market crew order
events.description: The organizers & ride operators placed a bulk food order for the night crew. Prepare it before opening.

events.name: Tour bus group
events.description: A group of tourists placed a bulk drink order for the bus. Prepare it before opening.

events.name: Cleaning levy
events.description: Officials are collecting an extra levy to clean up after tonight's event (Rp20,000).

events.name: Ferris wheel broken
events.description: The Ferris wheel is under repair, so fewer people come to the night market.

events.name: Market traders' order
events.description: The traders placed a bulk order of fried snacks & food to keep them going on their watch. Prepare it before opening.
